# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read and follow the repository's canonical agent guidance:

- [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — universal entrypoint
- [`.agents/AGENTS.md`](../.agents/AGENTS.md) — product boundaries and skill index
- [`.agents/OPERATING.md`](../.agents/OPERATING.md) — always-on operating norms
- [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/) — task-specific procedures

When a request matches a project skill, read that skill before proposing or
editing. Keep harness-specific instructions thin and aligned with the canonical
files above.
